tier1.text: The middle cardiac vein drains blood from parts of both ventricles, the heart's lower pumping chambers. This vein starts at the apex, the heart's lower tip, and runs up the back of the heart. The middle cardiac vein empties into the coronary sinus, a large vein that drains the heart.
